svg.text: Printed side down. Fold walls up, rim tabs inward.
The straight middle end joins the other hull half.
Score blue dashed lines before cutting. Cut bold outer outlines only; keep all pale glue tabs.
Fold walls up with the printed base facing down. Glue matching 1A, 1B, etc. behind their marked edges.
Fold the DECK rim tabs inward. Glue the two straight JOIN end walls back-to-back; keep both bottoms level.
This is a simplified waterline model: the underwater hull, tiny fittings and weapons are omitted.
A4 landscape | Actual size / 100% | Single-sided | No fit-to-page
